decisions.reason: The air cooled condenser fits the firm's announced efficiency and air-cooling direction, and the engineering already invested argues for persistence, although the withdrawal of the similar Product A shows the firm will prune overlapping single-tube variants.

Management has publicly committed to this condenser and is inclined to justify it as serving a distinct application, but its overlap with Product B makes it the most likely candidate for consolidation.
The tube liner strengthens the lifecycle service business the firm emphasizes, costs little to maintain, and slow uptake can still be attributed to the long sales cycles of repair solutions.
The multi-model customized air cooler line embodies the firm's core promise of customized integrated solutions and carries heavy sunk investment, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The tube end repair inserts are a low-cost complement to the service portfolio that supports the firm's lifecycle commitments to customers, so management keeps them.
